actor.detail: 用户纠正 Q40：agent 自录会死循环，须跳脱 agent 建独立进程监听捕获（含 hooks）。写 questions/041.md 并追加本 qna_recorded 事件：out-of-process daemon + feeder hooks + watcher 设计。

source.user_prompt: Don't go far away. I need to trace everything of input/output it's definitely including hooks so I am not specifically talking about trace hooks it's because it's part of the output. If you use agent to trace, you will definitely fall into a death loop. You need to jump out of the agent and think about that, probably something like creating a process, listening the agents and then capture the information

operation.change_summary: 记录 Q41：纠正 Q40 的 agent 侧记录会死循环，给出 out-of-process daemon(socket 唯一写入者)+feeder hooks(外部命令记 hook 触发)+watcher(kqueue/fsevents 被动看 transcript/.turn) 架构，agent 从不写 trace 故无回归。

qna.question: 要录一切 input/output 肯定含 hooks；用 agent 去 trace 会死循环。要跳脱 agent——建独立进程监听 agent 捕获。hooks 怎么被捕获？
qna.answer_summary: 记录器必须活在 agent 外：daemon(socket)是唯一 trace 写入者，hooks 作外部 feeder 命令把 payload 发 daemon（hook 触发即被记成事件），watcher 用 kqueue/fsevents 被动看会话 transcript 与 .turn 状态。agent 从不写 trace→无 log-the-log 死循环。第0步实测 payload 与 transcript。

comments: source.model 取平台可信信号失败（env CODEBUDDY_MODEL 缺失）→ unknown + model_confidence=unknown，按 Q18 禁止 agent 自报 Hy3。本事件为 Q40 方法的纠正：从『hook 驱动记录器』升级为『进程外 daemon 观察者』以规避 agent 自录死循环。
